name: Goldena Twin
shortDescription: A completed project of about 12 duplex villas in Kamala, a short distance from the beach.
description: A completed project of about 12 duplex villas in Kamala, a short distance from the beach. The 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom homes have around 150 sqm of built area, a private pool and a small garden, with mountain views. Shared services include security, a gym and an estate manager.
parking: 16 spaces, 80% parking-to-unit ratio, conventional, guaranteed car park per unit
